evidence.quote: alr-20261022-0107 | 2026-10-22T06:00:00Z | date_consistency | Data quality check: 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 have an order_ts outside 2026-10-20 (UTC) | open | NULL
evidence.why: Alert states 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 have an order_ts outside 2026-10-20 UTC.
Query confirms exactly 508 orders in run_date 2026-10-20 have timestamps between 2026-10-21T00:00:27Z and 2026-10-21T03:59:42Z (implying a 4-hour offset window from 00:00 to 04:00).

next_checks: Verify vendor API date parameter handling and whether the vendor groups orders by a non-UTC timezone boundary (e.g., UTC-4).
args.root_cause: The upstream vendor API groups orders by a local timezone or offset window rather than strict UTC calendar days. Consequently, orders up to 4 AM on the following day are returned under the previous day's date query, shifting timestamps across the UTC date boundary.
args.suggested_fix: Adjust the data ingestion or date filtering logic to account for the vendor's timezone offset, or filter/re-bucket orders strictly by their UTC order_ts into the correct run_date.
